data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Marchio', meaning 'soldier' or 'commander'. The name was adopted by the French nobility in the Middle Ages, becoming synonymous with noble rank. In the context of Christianity, Marquis can symbolize leadership and protection.

in_greek.name: Μαρκήσιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο τίτλος Μαρκήσιος προέρχεται από τη γαλλική λέξη 'marquis', που σημαίνει 'ευγενής' ή 'άρχοντας'. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία, οι τίτλοι ευγενείας όπως ο Μαρκήσιος συνδέονταν με την πνευματική ηγεσία και την αριστοκρατία του πνεύματος.

in_latin.name: Marquis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Marquis originem habet in titulo nobili, qui significat dominum seu nobilem. In ecclesia primitiva, huiusmodi tituli nobilitatis coniuncti erant cum spirituali ductu et aristocratia spiritus.

in_english.name: Marquis
in_english.meaning: A noble title, signifying a high-ranking lord or nobleman
in_english.long_meaning: The name Marquis originates from the French title 'marquis', meaning 'noble' or 'lord'. In Christian tradition, Marquis is associated with nobility, high social standing, and spiritual leadership. The name conveys a sense of dignity, power, and prestige. Historically, Marquis was a title of nobility ranking below a duke and above an earl. The name has been adopted in various Christian cultures, symbolizing nobility of character and spiritual excellence.

biblical_reference.note: The name Marquis is not directly mentioned in the Bible but is related to concepts of nobility and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Marquis has its roots in the Roman military, where the term referred to a high-ranking officer in the army. Over time, it became a title of nobility in Europe, particularly in France. As a noble title, it came to signify power, wealth, and distinction. The name has been borne by numerous influential figures throughout history, from medieval knights to modern-day business magnates.
data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name Marquis can symbolize leadership and protection. The Lord is often referred to as the "Commander of the Heavenly Army" (Joshua 5:14), emphasizing His role as a great Leader and Protector. As God's children, we are called to exercise leadership and protection over our families, communities, and the world around us. The name Marquis can serve as a reminder of this calling, inspiring us to emulate the leadership and protection of our heavenly Father. Furthermore, the name can be a source of inspiration and encouragement for those in positions of leadership, reminding them of the immense responsibility and power that comes with that role.

historical_references.reference: Marquis de Sade (1740-1814) was a French author and philosopher known for his libertine and sexually explicit works.
